jp_inflam_eze.name: Inflam-Eze Plus
jp_inflam_eze.key: 3 capsules: ginger 800 mg, curcumin-fenugreek blend (CurQfen) 250 mg, boswellia 250 mg, white willow 200 mg, hops 150 mg, devil's claw 60 mg
jp_inflam_eze.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Inflam-Eze Plus SS ND516' (Rev. 5/25, Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/), as transcribed in scratchpad labels/labels.json: per 3 capsules ginger powder 800 mg; CurQfen (curcumin extract 35% curcuminoids + fenugreek galactomannans) 250 mg; Boswellia serrata gum extract 65% boswellic acid 250 mg; white willow bark extract 25% salicin 200 mg; hops extract 2% xanthohumol 150 mg; devil's claw extract 1.2% harpagosides 60 mg; directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'. CurQfen is printed as a 'Proprietary Mix of Curcumin Extract (35% curcuminoids) and Fenugreek Galactomannans Extract', so the line says 'curcumin-fenugreek blend', not curcumin. Capsule: hypromellose (other ingredients, same sell sheet). Matches products DB R856 (catalog ND143 10/1/26 via the Ortho Molecular, Metagenics and Nutritional Frontiers switch charts). Sizes R856 90C / R856L 180C from price list ND144 10/1/26. URL slug from build/products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc); nutridyn.com is blocked from this machine, so the link was not re-checked.

jp_chondro_ic.name: Chondro-Relief Intensive Care
jp_chondro_ic.key: 4 capsules: glucosamine HCl 500 mg, chondroitin sulfate 400 mg, MSM 1 g, hyaluronic acid 100 mg, green-lipped mussel 1 g, plus vitamin C and manganese
jp_chondro_ic.src: Products DB R160 label_facts (Nutritional Frontiers switch charts 'Ha Plus' and 'Green Lipped Mussel', read from NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26): glucosamine 500 mg (HCl, 4 capsules), chondroitin sulfate 400 mg, MSM 1 g, hyaluronic acid 100 mg, green-lipped mussel powder 1 g; directions 'Take four capsules daily with food'. Also in scratchpad labels/labels.json (R160). Vitamin C and manganese (as manganese ascorbate) are still in the formula: the Chondro Relief Clinical Guide ND181 (Rev. 3/22, Dropbox Marketing Materials) lists them among the IC ingredients. Their only printed amounts (vitamin C 38 mg, manganese 15 mg per 4 capsules) are from the June 2014 catalog, so the line names them without numbers. 15 mg would be above the adult upper limit for manganese (11 mg a day, Institute of Medicine 2001): read the current bottle panel before printing. ASU (2014 catalog) is not in the 2022 guide, so it is left out. No current sell sheet was found. All four capsules are scheduled with the evening meal, inside the label's 'four capsules daily with food'. Size 120C from price list ND144 10/1/26. No product URL known: the link falls back to the catalog search.

jp_joint_eze.name: Joint Eze
jp_joint_eze.key: 1 capsule: undenatured collagen blend (UC-II) 20 mg, hops extract 50 mg, magnesium 37.5 mg
jp_joint_eze.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Joint Eze SS ND512' (Rev. 8/24, Dropbox Marketing Materials), as transcribed in scratchpad labels/labels.json: per capsule magnesium (bisglycinate chelate, TRAACS) 37.5 mg, hops extract 2% xanthohumol 50 mg, undenatured collagen blend (UC-II) 20 mg (printed as a blend, so the sheet says 'UC-II blend' and never implies 20 mg of UC-II itself); directions 'Take one capsule twice daily with food'; caution 'Do not use if pregnant or nursing'. Matches products DB R340 (Pure Encapsulations chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size 60C from price list ND144 10/1/26. No product URL known: the link falls back to the catalog search.

jp_collagen_renew.name: Collagen Renew
jp_collagen_renew.key: 1 scoop: 17.5 g bovine collagen peptides (FORTIGEL, FORTIBONE and TENDOFORTE 5 g each, VERISOL 2.5 g)
jp_collagen_renew.dosesub: in 8 oz water or a smoothie
jp_collagen_renew.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Collagen Renew SS ND569' (Rev. 9/24, Dropbox Marketing Materials), as transcribed in scratchpad labels/labels.json: per scoop (17.5 g) collagen peptides 17.5 g = FORTIGEL 5 g + FORTIBONE 5 g + TENDOFORTE 5 g + VERISOL 2.5 g; protein 15 g; about 30 servings; other ingredients 'Bovine Collagen Peptides' (hence 'bovine' here and the alpha-gal line in the check panel); directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water, your favorite beverage, or a recipe'. Matches products DB R190 (5 switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26) and the repo blast blasts/2026-10-19-collagen-tendon.html (panel read live; no vitamin C in the formula, hence the 'pair with a vitamin C food' line). URL from that blast (curl 200 on 2026-08-11). Size 525G from price list ND144 10/1/26.

jp_curcumin_400x.name: Curcumin 400X
jp_curcumin_400x.src: Products DB R268 label_facts (Pure Encapsulations and Designs for Health switch charts, read from NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'Turmeric extract per serving: NutriDyn 800 mg BioCurc extract (2 softgels, curcuminoid percentage not stated)'; directions 'Take two softgels daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' No curcuminoid amount is printed, so none is stated. 'Liquid-Soluble' is read off the bottle photo (R268: 'Curcumin 400x, Revolutionary Liquid-Soluble Curcumin'). Size 60 softgels from price list ND144 10/1/26 (DB sku R268 60S). Both softgels are scheduled at breakfast, inside 'two softgels daily'. URL slug curcumin-400x-r268 from build/products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc); nutridyn.com is blocked from this machine, so the link was not re-checked. Own key (not the shared curcumin_bcm95, whose line reads '800 mg curcumin') so the In each serving line matches the label wording.
